paragraphs: Rav Ashi of Hutzal, in Babylonia, instituted a washing vessel there. Heilprin first reports Rav Huna telling Rabbi Avin bar Avin, “Rabbi Ashi of Hutzal agrees with you” (see Acha of Hutzal). Kiddushin 58, beginning of b: Chiyya bar Avin asked Huna, etc.; “I mean Rav Assi of Hutzal agrees with you.”
